feature: Small items 2, item 8 and small items 3, item 8: quick-add's failed search says so in the shared deck toast, with Try again, and every deck toast stands in one stack 10px above the quick-add dock (the receipt on the floor, the one alert above it)
note: Run against a deck the signed-in account owns (QAF_DECK). The search is a Server Action POSTed to the deck's own URL, so the failure is forced by mocking that URL with a 500 AFTER the page has loaded; the toasts render into the shell's deck toast stack, outside `main`, so each row waits on it with `waitToast`. The page is reused across rows, so each row unroutes its mock last. `receipt-failed` WRITES and never reverts: it presses Bought on a Shopping row and adds one copy, so run it on a scratch Neon branch only (never staging or production), against a server started with SHOPPING_MARK_BOUGHT_ENABLED=true and COLLECTION_EDIT_ENABLED=true, with QAF_SHOP_DECK a deck holding Shopping rows; each cell takes a row off that list. `refusal-failed` presses a row's ✕ under the same 500, which the server answers as a refused removal: nothing is written. The press is outside the bar, so it clears the field (and the failed search with it); the refusal is the one alert left, never a third toast.

shares.note: The deck slot's toast frame, the one the got-it receipt draws. The failed-search toast renders it as-is (placement "deck"), never a copy of its look.

rows.label: /decks/[id]: a quick-add search that failed. The toast stands 10px above the dock; the field keeps "sw" and focus, no list opens
/decks/[id]: the same failure, then a search that lands (typing on). The toast is gone and the list opens
/decks/[id] All (WRITING): a receipt from Shopping on the floor, 10px above the dock, and the failed search 10px above it
/decks/[id]: a removal refused while the failed search was up. The refusal takes the one alert's place, 10px above the dock
